rawOperationDefinition: JSON Pointer paths; scalars or type changes replace; absent whole values add/remove. Arrays are initially compared by index. These exact operations are not semantic conclusions; identity-aligned audit reports below qualify sequence changes.

method.input: git show <commit>:<path>; no checkout, browser, validators, or workspace writes
method.dictionaryAlignment: Key identity; dictionary insertion order has no semantics
method.objectArrayAlignment: Each nonempty object array matched by its collision-free natural key, recursively; no index-based record attribution
method.primitiveArrayAlignment: Compare ordered values directly; no primitive-array changes found
method.metadataTreatment: Timestamps/refresh times, source ETag/byte counts, and source/artifact hash references are reported separately, never treated as changes to gameplay or statistics
method.scopeLimit: Audit classifies values in these two committed JSON files; it does not establish why upstream HTTP payloads changed or perform runtime verification

interpretation.factualChange: 2026_05_IND_PIT (Indianapolis at Pittsburgh, Week 5, 2026-10-11): dataset odds total decreases from 44.5 to 43.5 (-1.0); three materialized JSON copies change consistently.
unchangedDomainAreas: player seasonStats, stats tiles, and last5
roster verification decisions, conflicts, unavailable-field declarations
interpretation.rosterProvenance: All 80 players update two retrieval/check timestamps and the official/ESPN roster source hashes (320 leaves); Bradyn Swinson (00-0040176; ESPN 4431424) also updates the athlete response source hash (1 leaf). His identity and roster facts are unchanged.
interpretation.playerHistoryReference: Only playerHistory.generatedAt, playerHistory.currentSourceHashes.nflverse_games, and playerHistory.sha256 change in this file; underlying player-history.json is outside this audit scope.

unchangedDomainAreas: all 32 team records and identity fields
all 1,088 game record occurrences across the 32 team games arrays
all game stats and statsProvenance values
all roster/player records, seasonStats and last5
all depth data and roster verification data
interpretation.sourceByteCountNote: 22 ESPN summary response byte counts decrease; these are source-payload bookkeeping values, not game statistics. Source IDs, URLs, providers, HTTP/status/required fields are unchanged.

summary.conclusion: current.json contains one consistent betting-line update (three copies); team-details.json has no domain/factual change. All remaining changed values are metadata.
summary.identityStrategy: Use id for teams, standings, roster, games and sources; playerId for leaders; gameId for last5 and historical prices; label for stat tiles; field for single-subject issues/unavailable; playerId+week for injury reports; playerId+unit+position for depth records; playerId/team/field or gameId/playerId/team/field for cross-record disagreements. Every chosen key is unique in its array at both commits.

conclusion.stableFacts: All common team, roster, tracked-player, game, stat, advanced-stat, appearance, starting-role, QB-coverage, depth-position and depth-rank facts remain unchanged. Retained fixture-player status, injury, practice and inactive facts are unchanged.
conclusion.actualDatasetChanges: Three fixture-availability identities added and three removed in TEN/WAS current-week provider reports; ten provider chronology replacements across seven retained identities, including PHI/TB copies into future-event current-team bulletins. Nine record-array sequences differ; the 25-row QB missing-statistics sequence is a pure permutation.
conclusion.interpretation: The changed membership/order is a provider report representation, with completeOfficialList false. Removing a player from this partial report proves neither recovery nor active eligibility nor roster removal. Added and removed entries are all provider-reported Questionable, reportedInactive null and officialConfirmed false.
conclusion.limitation: This source audit supplies authoritative endpoint URLs and exact source-book assertions. External HTTP confirmation belongs to the parent audit; no new public response or runtime/browser behavior is claimed here.

identityAlignment.strategy: Team dictionary keys; source/roster id; tracked-player dictionary keys; team/H2H game id; gameLog by (gameId,team) within team/player; depth by (playerId or espnId,unit,position), comparing rank as content; fixture availability by playerId or espnId; repeated injury bulletins by (playerId or espnId,position,sourceIds); disagreements by (team,playerId,gameId,field); QB missing-statistics/uncorroborated rows by (playerId,gameId).
identityAlignment.uniqueKeyChecks: Every keyed array checked on both sides; zero collisions or unhandled dictionary arrays. Repeated DAL Malik Davis and PIT Donte Kent/Rico Dowdle injury records preserve separate position roles.
identityAlignment.primitiveArrays: Values and position preserved; no primitive-array changes.
identityAlignment.stableIdentityDomains: All team/source/roster/tracked-player/team-game/H2H/player-game/depth identity sets are unchanged; only two fixture availability arrays change members.

operationAccounting.definition: Leaf replace or whole added/removed value counts once. Aligned membership changes are whole identity-record operations, not JSON Patch move counts.

unchangedContentEvidence.ranks: All 210 stored depth ranks, ranking contract and ranking input pool/statistics unchanged; rendered application ranks were not recomputed.
unchangedContentEvidence.snapshotContract: schemaVersion=1, season=2026, currentWeek=5, throughWeek=5 and top-level provenance text unchanged.
unchangedContentEvidence.sourceContracts: 125 source IDs, URLs, providers, required flags, HTTP statuses, verification/TLS statuses unchanged.

quarterbackCoverage.preservation: All 25 missing-statistics records, notes and source IDs preserved. Twelve uncorroborated and twelve disputed-role records remain. Hash/retrieval refreshes do not create starts/statistics, remove unknown QB slots, choose a provider or substitute older games.

provenanceRefresh.chronologyDistinction: 210 depth snapshot timestamps advance together while all depth identities/positions/ranks are stable; ten actual provider report timestamp changes are retained separately and not blanket-classified as metadata.

builderQualification.providerSelection: fixture_report checks exact event/season/week/team identity, then loops matching team injuries[].injuries[] and appends every item in provider order. No local five-row slicing, sorting or deduplication occurs. Both affected provider representations contain five records before/after; provider order can change while common statuses remain unchanged.
builderQualification.contractQuote: Not an exhaustive official inactive list; absence does not establish active/healthy status.

identityStrategy.players: Map keys are stable playerId; also compare each embedded id.
identityStrategy.games: Map keys are stable gameId within playerId. Independently align rows by (playerId, gameId, season, week, seasonType, team, opponent). Compare every retained row field, including stats, rawStats, rawLists, dates, kickoffUtc, scores, result, positions, and sourceIds.
identityStrategy.byOpponent: Map key is stable opponent team abbreviation within playerId; gameIds arrays aligned by exact gameId and checked for sequence changes.
identityStrategy.sources: Align sources array by unique id rather than index; compare id sequence separately for ordering.
identityStrategy.scalarArrays: Align available/unavailable seasons by season value, opponents by team abbreviation, last5 and byOpponent/gameIds by gameId, and sourceIds by source id; retain multiset multiplicity and compare exact sequences.
identityStrategy.emptyArrays: unavailableSeasons and disagreements are empty in both blobs.

factualEvidence.projectionDefinition: Remove only top-level generatedAt/retrievedAt/currentSourceHashes; per-game retrievedAt/scheduleRetrievedAt; per-source retrievedAt/sha256/etag/lastModified. Preserve every other field and all scalar array sequences. Align source records by id.

risks.description: nflverse_games source sha256 and ETag changed; this audit proves factual equality only for the retained player-history JSON projection, not for every upstream schedule row or other files.

No player/game/season/week/team/opponent identity additions/removals, factual row changes, scalar-array ordering changes, or source-array identity changes found. No browser, repository validator, application code, checkout/rebase, or prior source audit used or modified.

savedValidatorAndCanonicalIntegrityEvide.execution: The exact three saved-data validator commands were run with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1. Their --check branches read saved JSON and return before refresh/writes. No browser, app/code/test, prior audit, or data changes made.
